payload.summary: CME and On Call have no two-user staging isolation proof; the cross-tenant harness covers documents/search/answer only (audit F17)
payload.detail: Verified offline: scripts/test-cross-tenant-staging.ts exercises /api/answer, /api/documents, /api/health, /api/search and /api/search/universal and has zero CME or On Call references. Unit-level root-bundle isolation tests exist (cme-root-bundle-isolation, on-call-root-bundle-isolation) but are not endpoint attacks. Next action: extend the existing two-user harness to CME records/evidence/storage signed URLs and On Call services/invitations/membership/reports/orientation, including revocation and concurrency races. Staging execution is provider-backed and needs explicit approval. Related: #057 (runs the existing harness; does not widen it).
